title: Crispy French Fruit Fritters
description: Delicate French pastry fritters filled with sweet fruit and deep-fried to a crispy perfection.
instructions: Combine warm milk and egg in a large bowl.
In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, and a pinch of salt.
Gradually pour dry ingredients into the wet ingredients and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Heat the oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F.
Using a spoon, drop small amounts of the batter into the oil, about 1 tablespoon each.
Fry the fritters for 2-3 minutes or until golden brown, flipping them halfway through.
Drain the fritters on paper towels and let cool for a minute.
Fill each fritter with mixed fruit and serve warm.
Serve immediately, dust with powdered sugar if desired.
